tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Fetch one user row (public neighbourhood profile) by id
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = :id

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List users filtered by role/suburb/postcode (neighbourhood directory)
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE (:role IS NULL OR role = :role) AND (:suburb IS NULL OR suburb = :suburb) AND (:postcode IS NULL OR postcode = :postcode) ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: create_me
tools.description: Create the caller's own user row with a chosen role (first-time onboarding; id is the verified caller)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO users (id, email, name, photo_url, role, suburb, postcode, state, country, lat, lng, client_profile, mower_profile, street_group_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:__user_id, :email, :name, :photo_url, :role, :suburb, :postcode, :state, :country, :lat, :lng, :client_profile, :mower_profile, NULL, :__now, :__now)

tools.name: update_me
tools.description: Update the caller's own user row (profile fields; only supplied fields change, others keep their value)
tools.sql: UPDATE users SET email = CASE WHEN :set_email = 1 THEN :email ELSE email END, name = CASE WHEN :set_name = 1 THEN :name ELSE name END, photo_url = CASE WHEN :set_photo_url = 1 THEN :photo_url ELSE photo_url END, role = CASE WHEN :set_role = 1 THEN :role ELSE role END, suburb = CASE WHEN :set_suburb = 1 THEN :suburb ELSE suburb END, postcode = CASE WHEN :set_postcode = 1 THEN :postcode ELSE postcode END, state = CASE WHEN :set_state = 1 THEN :state ELSE state END, country = CASE WHEN :set_country = 1 THEN :country ELSE country END, lat = CASE WHEN :set_lat = 1 THEN :lat ELSE lat END, lng = CASE WHEN :set_lng = 1 THEN :lng ELSE lng END, client_profile = CASE WHEN :set_client_profile = 1 THEN :client_profile ELSE client_profile END, mower_profile = CASE WHEN :set_mower_profile = 1 THEN :mower_profile ELSE mower_profile END, street_group_id = CASE WHEN :set_street_group_id = 1 THEN :street_group_id ELSE street_group_id END, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :__user_id

tools.name: admin_set_role
tools.description: Set any user's role (platform admins only — caller must be a user with role='admin')
tools.sql: UPDATE users SET role = :role, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')

tools.name: admin_delete_user
tools.description: Delete any user (platform admins only — caller must be a user with role='admin')
tools.sql: DELETE FROM users WHERE id = :user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: List street groups filtered by status/suburb/postcode/assigned mower
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM street_groups WHERE (:status IS NULL OR status = :status) AND (:suburb IS NULL OR suburb = :suburb) AND (:postcode IS NULL OR postcode = :postcode) AND (:mower_id IS NULL OR assigned_mower_id = :mower_id) ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: Fetch one street group by id
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM street_groups WHERE id = :id

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Create a street group with the caller as its sole admin and member (created_by is the verified caller)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO street_groups (id, name, street_name, suburb, postcode, state, country, center_lat, center_lng, admin_ids, member_ids, assigned_mower_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id, :name, :street_name, :suburb, :postcode, :state, :country, :center_lat, :center_lng, json_array(:__user_id), json_array(:__user_id), NULL, 'forming', :__now, :__now)

tools.name: update_group
tools.description: Update a street group's profile/status/assigned mower (group admins or platform admins only)
tools.sql: UPDATE street_groups SET name = CASE WHEN :set_name = 1 THEN :name ELSE name END, street_name = CASE WHEN :set_street_name = 1 THEN :street_name ELSE street_name END, suburb = CASE WHEN :set_suburb = 1 THEN :suburb ELSE suburb END, postcode = CASE WHEN :set_postcode = 1 THEN :postcode ELSE postcode END, state = CASE WHEN :set_state = 1 THEN :state ELSE state END, country = CASE WHEN :set_country = 1 THEN :country ELSE country END, center_lat = CASE WHEN :set_center_lat = 1 THEN :center_lat ELSE center_lat END, center_lng = CASE WHEN :set_center_lng = 1 THEN :center_lng ELSE center_lng END, status = CASE WHEN :set_status = 1 THEN :status ELSE status END, assigned_mower_id = CASE WHEN :set_assigned_mower_id = 1 THEN :assigned_mower_id ELSE assigned_mower_id END, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(street_groups.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))

tools.name: add_group_member
tools.description: Add a user to a group's member list (self-join, or a group admin / platform admin adding someone). No-op if already a member.
tools.sql: UPDATE street_groups SET member_ids = json_insert(member_ids, '$[#]', :user_id), updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :group_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(member_ids) WHERE value = :user_id) AND (:user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))

tools.name: remove_group_member
tools.description: Remove a user from a group's member list (self-leave, or a group admin / platform admin removing someone)
tools.sql: UPDATE street_groups SET member_ids = (SELECT COALESCE(json_group_array(value), json_array()) FROM json_each(member_ids) WHERE value != :user_id), updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :group_id AND (:user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))

tools.name: add_group_admin
tools.description: Add a user to a group's admin list (existing group admins or platform admins only). No-op if already an admin.
tools.sql: UPDATE street_groups SET admin_ids = json_insert(admin_ids, '$[#]', :user_id), updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :group_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value = :user_id) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))

tools.name: remove_group_admin
tools.description: Remove a user from a group's admin list (existing group admins or platform admins only)
tools.sql: UPDATE street_groups SET admin_ids = (SELECT COALESCE(json_group_array(value), json_array()) FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value != :user_id), updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))

tools.name: delete_group
tools.description: Delete a group and all its schedules, interests, mower-interests and votes atomically (group admins or platform admins only)
statements: DELETE FROM schedules WHERE group_id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))

DELETE FROM street_group_interests WHERE group_id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))

DELETE FROM mower_interest_votes WHERE interest_id IN (SELECT id FROM mower_interests WHERE group_id = :group_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))

DELETE FROM mower_interests WHERE group_id = :group_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))

DELETE FROM street_groups WHERE id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(street_groups.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))

tools.name: create_group_interest
tools.description: Express the caller's interest in joining a street group (upsert on group+user; the caller is the applicant)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO street_group_interests (id, group_id, user_id, message, created_at) VALUES (:id, :group_id, :__user_id, :message, :__now) ON CONFLICT (group_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET message = excluded.message, created_at = excluded.created_at

tools.name: list_group_interests
tools.description: List join-interest requests for a group, newest first (group admins or platform admins only)
tools.sql: SELECT i.* FROM street_group_interests i JOIN street_groups g ON g.id = i.group_id WHERE i.group_id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')) ORDER BY i.created_at DESC

tools.name: delete_group_interest
tools.description: Delete a group join-interest — either the applicant themselves, or a group admin / platform admin of the target group
tools.sql: DELETE FROM street_group_interests WHERE id = :id AND (user_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = street_group_interests.group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))))

tools.name: list_schedules
tools.description: List a group's schedules ordered by due date then day of week
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM schedules WHERE group_id = :group_id ORDER BY due_date ASC NULLS LAST, day_of_week ASC NULLS LAST

tools.name: list_schedules_for_mower
tools.description: List schedules assigned to a mower, most recent due first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM schedules WHERE mower_id = :mower_id ORDER BY due_date DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: create_schedule
tools.description: Create a schedule for a group (group admins or platform admins only)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO schedules (id, group_id, day_of_week, start_time, mower_id, status, due_date, completed_at, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :id, :group_id, :day_of_week, :start_time, :mower_id, 'planned', :due_date, NULL, :__now, :__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = :group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))

tools.name: update_schedule
tools.description: Update a schedule (group admins/platform admins, or the assigned mower updating status/completion)
tools.sql: UPDATE schedules SET day_of_week = CASE WHEN :set_day_of_week = 1 THEN :day_of_week ELSE day_of_week END, start_time = CASE WHEN :set_start_time = 1 THEN :start_time ELSE start_time END, mower_id = CASE WHEN :set_mower_id = 1 THEN :mower_id ELSE mower_id END, status = CASE WHEN :set_status = 1 THEN :status ELSE status END, due_date = CASE WHEN :set_due_date = 1 THEN :due_date ELSE due_date END, completed_at = CASE WHEN :set_completed_at = 1 THEN :completed_at ELSE completed_at END, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND (schedules.mower_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = schedules.group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))))

tools.name: delete_schedule
tools.description: Delete a schedule (group admins or platform admins only)
tools.sql: DELETE FROM schedules WHERE id = :id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = schedules.group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))

tools.name: create_review
tools.description: Create a mower review authored by the caller (reviewer is the verified caller)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO mower_reviews (id, mower_id, reviewer_id, group_id, schedule_id, rating, comment, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id, :mower_id, :__user_id, :group_id, :schedule_id, :rating, :comment, :__now, :__now)

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.description: List reviews for a mower, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM mower_reviews WHERE mower_id = :mower_id ORDER BY created_at DESC

tools.name: update_review
tools.description: Update the caller's own review (only the review's author may edit)
tools.sql: UPDATE mower_reviews SET rating = CASE WHEN :set_rating = 1 THEN :rating ELSE rating END, comment = CASE WHEN :set_comment = 1 THEN :comment ELSE comment END, updated_at = :__now WHERE id = :id AND reviewer_id = :__user_id

tools.name: delete_review
tools.description: Delete a review — either its author, or a platform admin
tools.sql: DELETE FROM mower_reviews WHERE id = :id AND (reviewer_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))

tools.name: average_rating
tools.description: Average rating and review count for a mower
tools.sql: SELECT AVG(rating) AS avg, COUNT(*) AS n FROM mower_reviews WHERE mower_id = :mower_id

tools.name: record_history
tools.description: Record a completed-job history entry for the caller as the mower (mower_id is the verified caller)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO history_records (id, mower_id, group_id, schedule_id, street_name, area_sqm, duration_min, income, date) VALUES (:id, :__user_id, :group_id, :schedule_id, :street_name, :area_sqm, :duration_min, :income, :date)

tools.name: list_history
tools.description: List a mower's job history, most recent first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM history_records WHERE mower_id = :mower_id ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT :limit

tools.name: list_interests_for_group
tools.description: List mowers who have expressed interest in servicing a group, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM mower_interests WHERE group_id = :group_id ORDER BY created_at DESC

tools.name: list_interests_for_mower
tools.description: List the groups a mower has expressed interest in, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM mower_interests WHERE mower_id = :mower_id ORDER BY created_at DESC

tools.name: create_mower_interest
tools.description: Express the caller's (a mower's) interest in servicing a group (upsert on mower+group; the caller is the mower)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO mower_interests (id, group_id, mower_id, message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id, :group_id, :__user_id, :message, :__now, :__now) ON CONFLICT (mower_id, group_id) DO UPDATE SET message = excluded.message, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

tools.name: delete_mower_interest
tools.description: Delete a mower interest and its votes atomically — either the mower who owns it, or a group admin / platform admin of the target group
statements: DELETE FROM mower_interest_votes WHERE interest_id = :id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mower_interests mi WHERE mi.id = :id AND (mi.mower_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = mi.group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin')))))

DELETE FROM mower_interests WHERE id = :id AND (mower_id = :__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM street_groups g WHERE g.id = mower_interests.group_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(g.admin_ids) WHERE value = :__user_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users a WHERE a.id = :__user_id AND a.role = 'admin'))))

tools.name: cast_vote
tools.description: Cast or change the caller's vote on a mower interest (voter is the verified caller; upsert on interest+voter)
tools.sql: INSERT INTO mower_interest_votes (interest_id, voter_id, vote, created_at) VALUES (:interest_id, :__user_id, :vote, :__now) ON CONFLICT(interest_id, voter_id) DO UPDATE SET vote = excluded.vote, created_at = excluded.created_at

tools.name: list_votes
tools.description: List all votes on a mower interest, newest first
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM mower_interest_votes WHERE interest_id = :interest_id ORDER BY created_at DESC

tools.name: vote_tally
tools.description: Up/down vote counts for a mower interest
tools.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN vote = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS up, SUM(CASE WHEN vote = -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS down FROM mower_interest_votes WHERE interest_id = :interest_id
